title: Implement one arbitrary-input once-rounded selected MOVE as a literal tape graph (no kappa)
body:
## Result
Implement selected MOVE24472 on arbitrary signed inputs using a fixed 54-tape graph, paid widening and one final nearest-UP round. Prove direct time/history bounds and restored owners; reject true final overflow before public writes.

## Checks and limits
84,935 locations; all 82,813 embedded core instructions checked; independent full 25,467,658-step packet and exact converter/source checks. Supplied packed entry and cutoff remain premises. The selected exact-layer route requires another caller/error proof before interior substitution. No new kappa; all five global assumptions remain.

## Credit
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance. Credit #7211, #7426, #7428, #7429, #7430, #7468 and the pinned Gaussian/core lineage.

[Complete description, exact pins, reproduction and limitations](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c68c9d55b518c997fe5f53d127810e4009e9903/research/literal-once-rounded-selected-move/PR-DESCRIPTION.md).
